scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Deterministic quasipolynomial-time mean-payoff games” (preprints/Deterministic-quasipolynomial-time-mean-payoff-games-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 104 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5d8d8876fd2982fd), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: A uniform deterministic algorithm returns exactly the set U =   v ∈ V : ∃ Max strategy σ ∀ Min strategies τ, MPw(πv,σ,τ ) ≥ 0 for every game specified above. For an absolute constant C > 0, the complete computation uses at most 2C(log2(L+2))2 bit operations in a standard model polynomially equivalent to a uniform deterministic Turing machine. The bound includes preprocessing, exact arithmetic, recursion, and output of the entire set U.
